activate_my_card: To activate your card, please visit our app or call the activation number on the sticker.
age_limit: Our accounts are available to customers aged 18 and above. Some products may have different age requirements.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: You can add your card to Apple Pay or Google Pay through the Wallet app on your device.
atm_support: Our cards are accepted at ATMs worldwide. Fees may apply for non-partner ATMs.
automatic_top_up: You can enable automatic top-up in the app under Settings > Top-up > Automatic.
balance_not_updated: Balances typically update within minutes. If yours hasn't, please wait 10 minutes and refresh.
beneficiary_not_allowed: Some transfer restrictions apply for new accounts or unverified beneficiaries. Please verify your identity first.
cancel_transfer: To cancel a pending transfer, go to Transfers in the app and select Cancel before it processes.
card_about_to_expire: We'll send a replacement card automatically before expiry. Check your registered address is up to date.
card_acceptance: Our cards are accepted at most Visa/Mastercard merchants worldwide. Contact us if you face repeated declines.
card_arrival: Cards typically arrive within 5–7 business days. Track delivery in the app under Card > Track.
card_linking: To link your card to an account or service, use the card number, expiry, and CVV shown in the app.
card_not_working: If your card isn't working, check it's activated, not frozen, and has sufficient balance.
card_payment_fee_charged: Payment fees vary by merchant country. Our fee schedule is available in the app under Fees.
card_payment_not_recognised: Unrecognised payments should be reported immediately. Go to Transactions > Dispute in the app.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Exchange rates are set at the time of transaction. You can view the rate applied in transaction details.
card_swallowed: If your card was swallowed by an ATM, please freeze it immediately in the app and contact us for a replacement.
cash_withdrawal_charge: Cash withdrawal charges depend on your plan and the ATM operator. Check your plan's fee schedule.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: If you don't recognise a cash withdrawal, freeze your card immediately and contact our support team.
change_pin: You can change your PIN in the app under Card > Change PIN, or at any compatible ATM.
compromised_card: If you believe your card is compromised, freeze it immediately in the app and we'll issue a replacement.
contactless_not_working: Ensure contactless is enabled in the app under Card Settings. Try moving the card closer to the terminal.
country_support: We support accounts in most countries. Check our supported countries list on the website.
declined_card_payment: Declines can happen due to insufficient balance, fraud checks, or merchant restrictions. Check the reason in the app.
declined_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal declines may be due to daily limits or ATM restrictions. Check your limits in the app.
declined_transfer: Transfers can be declined due to limits or compliance checks. Review the reason in Transfer History.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Unrecognised direct debits can be disputed in the app under Payments > Direct Debits.
disposable_card_limits: Disposable virtual cards have one-time use limits. Create a new one for each transaction in the app.
edit_personal_details: Update your personal details in the app under Profile > Edit Details.
exchange_charge: Currency exchange charges depend on your plan. Premium plans include free exchange up to set limits.
exchange_rate: Live exchange rates are shown in the app before any conversion. We use the interbank mid-market rate.
exchange_via_app: To exchange currency, go to the app, tap Exchange, select currencies, and confirm the amount.
extra_charge_on_statement: Unexpected charges should be reviewed in Transaction Details. Contact us if you'd like to dispute one.
failed_transfer: Failed transfers are usually due to incorrect details or limits. Check the error message in Transfer History.
fiat_currency_support: We support major fiat currencies. Check the full list under Exchange in the app.
freeze_card: Freeze your card instantly in the app under Card > Freeze. You can unfreeze at any time.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Create a disposable virtual card in the app under Cards > Virtual Card > Disposable.
get_physical_card: Order a physical card in the app under Cards > Order Physical Card.
getting_spare_card: You can order a spare card from the app. A small delivery fee may apply.
getting_virtual_card: Virtual cards are available instantly in the app under Cards > Virtual Card.
lost_or_stolen_card: If your card is lost or stolen, freeze it immediately in the app, then order a replacement.
modify_personal_details: You can modify your personal details in the app under Profile > Edit Details.
order_physical_card: Order a new physical card in the app under Cards > Order Physical Card.
passcode_forgotten: Reset your passcode via the app login screen by tapping 'Forgot Passcode' and following the steps.
pending_card_payment: Pending payments are pre-authorised and usually settle within 1–3 business days.
pending_cash_withdrawal: Pending cash withdrawals typically settle within 24 hours.
pending_top_up: Top-ups usually process within minutes. Bank transfers may take up to 2 business days.
pending_transfer: Transfers are usually instant. International transfers may take 1–3 business days.
pin_blocked: If your PIN is blocked after 3 incorrect attempts, you can reset it in the app under Card > Reset PIN.
receiving_money: Received money appears in your balance immediately. Check Transactions if you don't see it.
refund_not_showing: Merchant refunds typically take 3–5 business days to appear. Check Transaction History.
request_refund: To request a refund, contact the merchant first. If unresolved, raise a dispute in the app.
reverted_card_payment: Reverted payments return to your balance within 3–5 business days.
supported_cards_and_currencies: We support Visa, Mastercard, and most major currencies. Check the full list in the app.
terminate_account: To close your account, go to Profile > Settings > Close Account. Ensure your balance is zero first.
top_up_by_bank_transfer: Top up via bank transfer using the account details in the app under Top-up > Bank Transfer.
top_up_by_card: Add funds instantly with a debit card via Top-up > Card in the app.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Cash or cheque top-ups are not currently supported. Please use bank transfer or card.
top_up_failed: Top-up failures can occur due to card limits or bank restrictions. Try a different payment method.
top_up_limits: Top-up limits depend on your verification level. View your limits under Top-up in the app.
top_up_reverted: If your top-up was reverted, the funds will return to your source within 3–5 business days.
topping_up_by_card: To top up by card, go to Top-up > Card in the app and enter your card details.
transaction_charged_twice: Duplicate charges should be disputed. Go to Transactions > Dispute and select the affected payment.
transfer_fee_charged: Transfer fees vary by destination and plan. Check the fee before confirming in the app.
transfer_into_account: To receive a transfer, share your account details found under Profile > Account Details.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: If a transfer hasn't arrived, check the recipient's details were correct and allow 1–3 business days.
transfer_timing: Most transfers are instant. International transfers can take 1–3 business days.
unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification requires a valid ID and selfie. Ensure good lighting and document clarity.
unrecognised_top_up: If you don't recognise a top-up, review your bank statement and contact us immediately if suspicious.
user_verification_status: Check your verification status in the app under Profile > Verification.
verify_my_identity: To verify your identity, go to Profile > Verification and follow the on-screen steps.
verify_source_of_funds: We may ask you to verify the source of your funds for compliance purposes. Upload documents via the app.
verify_top_up: If asked to verify a top-up, provide the requested documents in the app under Verification.
virtual_card_not_working: Ensure your virtual card is active and not expired. Generate a new one if needed.
visa_or_mastercard: We issue both Visa and Mastercard cards depending on your region. Check your card type in the app.
why_verify_identity: Identity verification is required by financial regulations to keep your account secure.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: If you received the wrong cash amount at an ATM, contact us immediately with the date, ATM location, and amount.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The exchange rate for cash withdrawals is set by the ATM operator. Our rate applies to in-app conversions.
